title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

errors: No clear mathematical error. The uniqueness of λ_0 (marginal NB) is correctly flagged as problematic when 2 is neither invertible nor 0 on S. The statement ε_1 = −λ_0ρσ^{-1} requires ρ, σ to be lifted to SG or M^* first, which is only implicit here.
Some wording is too poorly legible to verify, e.g. which symbols 'n'interviennent plus'.

ideas.what: Rewriting the loop equation (132) as [α,ρ] = [β,σ]·γ with γ in the unipotent radical L_1 of a Borel: a commutator relation with a parabolic (unipotent) boundary condition in a form of PGL2 over a general base
ideas.modern_name: representation / character schemes of punctured-surface groups into (forms of) PGL2 with unipotent monodromy at the puncture
ideas.usually_credited_to: Fricke–Klein classically; Goldman, Culler–Shalen and others for character varieties
ideas.where_published: Theme of the 'équation des lacets' notes following La Longue Marche (1981); not published in this form

ideas.what: Identification PG ≅ Aut(G) ≅ Aut(M) ≅ Aut(P) for forms of PGL2, and borélien subgroups ↔ sections of the conic P
ideas.modern_name: inner forms of PGL2 / quaternion Azumaya algebras / conics
ideas.where_published: SGA 3; Le groupe de Brauer I

ideas.what: Lifting ρσ^{-1} from PG to a unipotent ε_1 via a scalar λ_0 and the uniqueness issue at the prime 2
ideas.modern_name: μ2-ambiguity of lifts SL2 → PGL2 over bases where 2 is not invertible

deep.surprise_reason: Intermediate computational step in a long unpublished calculation on loop equations in forms of PGL2. The only notable detail is the characteristic-2 caveat for λ_0, which is routine.
transcription_corrections: First line likely '... boréliens — l'équation 132,' (i.e. 'boréliens', referring to borélien additive subgroups), not 'bornées'.
In the parenthesis of line 2-3 the words before 'n'interviennent plus' are probably symbols (e.g. μ, ε_1), not 'ne'. Read it as '(où ... n'interviennent plus, seulement α et β)'.
(13) seems to read 'L̃_1 ⊂ PG_S' (subscript, maybe S) rather than 'PG' followed by a stray character.
The inserted phrase above line (16)'s continuation reads 'par commutativité' (probably), not 'pas commutativité'.
Marginal NB: approximately 'NB λ_0 est uniquement déterminé par ρ, σ si 2 inversible sur S, ou si 2 = 0 ... [condition on 2 in Γ(S, O_S)] ... Mais ... mal !!'.
The handwritten page number at the bottom is 294 (archive numbering); the neighbouring pages carry Grothendieck's own numbering 447/448.
